title: Rewrite resume bullets that say ‘responsible for’
scenario: Your resume has 8 bullets that all start with ‘Responsible for...’ or ‘Worked on...’. Recruiters skim resumes in 6 seconds. You want bullets that lead with the action, quantify the outcome, and don't lie when you don't have a number. One bullet is from a college fest you ran, one from an Excel project, one from a debate finalist. You want them rewritten so they sound real, not LinkedIn-influencer.
badPrompt: rewrite my resume bullets to be more impactful
badOutput:
1. Spearheaded cross-functional initiatives to drive impactful outcomes.
2. Leveraged strategic insights to optimize results.
3. Pioneered innovative solutions for organizational growth.
4. Championed dynamic projects with measurable success.

hints.title: Ban LinkedIn-influencer verbs
hints.body: ‘No spearheaded, no leveraged, no pioneered, no championed.’ Recruiters skim past these instantly.

hints.title: Force honest quantification
hints.body: ‘If I don't have a number, don't fabricate one. Use scope words instead, e.g., ‘team of 6’ or ‘12-stall fest’.’ Don't invent percentages.

checks.tip: Anchor the actual experiences, not generic.
Reference the recruiter skim context, 6 seconds.
Force honest quantification, no invented numbers.
Force action-led bullets, action verb at start.
Demand scope words when no metric exists, ‘team of 6’, ‘12-stall fest’.
Force a natural voice, not LinkedIn-influencer.

tipIfLow: Resume rewrites become Hindi-cinema dialogue when AI is unconstrained. The unlock is banning the cliché verbs (spearheaded, leveraged), forcing honest quantification (no invented %), AND demanding scope words when numbers don't exist. ‘Team of 6 in a 12-stall fest’ beats ‘championed dynamic outcomes’.
goldPrompt: Act as a recruiter who skims in 6 seconds. I'm Tara, 3rd-year B.Com. I have 8 bullets all starting with 'Responsible for...' or 'Worked on...'. Three real artifacts: a college fest I ran (12 stalls, team of 6), an Excel project for an internship (data-cleaning workbook), and a debate-finalist tag. Banned verbs: spearheaded, leveraged, pioneered, championed, drove. If I don't have a number for a bullet, do NOT invent one — use a scope phrase instead ('team of 6', '12-stall fest', '500-row dataset'). Output 8 rewritten bullets, each starting with an action verb, leading with the outcome where I have one, capping at 18 words.
